name: Loop · Glossy feature (square)
tagline: 1200x1200, 4 s seamless loop of one feature: glossy 3D props, floating cards, confetti and glints.
recipe: useLoop(): p runs 0->1 over the loop; osc() is a sine that always closes the loop; on(a) pops an element in at phase a and away before the restart, so the loop is seamless.
Stage with a 3-colour gradient, Floor shadow, Chip / Card / Phone / Star3D / Bot / Face / Toast / Msg props, Confetti and Glints.
One idea per loop, centred, readable at small size.
